top_signals.title: Chip Rout Deepens on China Competition, Circular Funding Fears
top_signals.summary: A global selloff in semiconductor stocks deepened on Tuesday, as fresh signs of China’s progress in advanced chipmaking and mounting concerns over the artificial intelligence spending boom sparked another wave of selling across the sector.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
